notes.title: Scientist Reveal: Shakti Raman!
notes.notes:
We are excited to show a glimpse of one of the Genomon Scientists in the WHITHERWARD ISLANDS. 

Introducing Shakti Raman!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39232050/2354430d189f00203a78e9bc4556c9d498dde726.png[/img]

[i]Name: [/i]
SHAKTI RAMAN

[i]Background:[/i]
Daughter of the Breakthrough Science Committee member Bana Raman. Efficient and serious-minded, if not socially awkward—perhaps owing to the fact that she’s spent the entirety of her life on a small, secluded Pacific island.

[i]Scientific Focus:[/i]
Growth Hormone Technology

[i]Species Native to Raman Island:[/i]
Octopus
Crab
Frog

[i]Catchphrase:[/i]
You wouldn't happen to know the wi-fi password here, would you?

notes.title: GENOMON: GENETIC MONSTERS FREE DEMO NOW AVAILABLE
notes.notes:
GENOMON: GENETIC MONSTERS FREE DEMO NOW AVAILABLE

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1048120/Genomon_Genetic_Monsters/]DEMO INSTALL PAGE[/url]

Try out a free demo for the upcoming game GENOMON: GENETIC MONSTERS. The demo features the first questline of the game along with the first battle island, animals, devices and decorations!

ABOUT THIS GAME

Even in the modern age, there are locations on Earth so remote that few people have ever heard, let alone visited. Among these obscure places are the WHITHERWARD ISLANDS, a collection of six islands in the South Pacific so distant from other landmasses, so removed from shipping lanes, strategic passages, and air routes that the world has nearly forgotten their existence.

Push the boundaries of science while battling the creations of rival genetic engineers on the beautiful and remote WHITHERWARD ISLANDS. EXTRACT, SEQUENCE and SPLICE DNA. INCUBATE, BATTLE and UPGRADE Genomon. Genomon is a genetic monster making lab and battling sandbox.
